summary: Independent initial canonical audit pinned to Jiuwudaishi 094 source and extraction. No source or extraction content was changed.

findings.problem: The Later Tang Zhuangzong / Wei-Bo sequence has borrowed the 923–926 reign window and, in one case, the wrong AD 923 point.
findings.action: Remove the borrowed 923–926 components and source the distinct events separately. In particular, do not treat the retrospective label Zhuangzong as proof that every narrated event belongs to his 923–926 imperial reign; verify the Wei-Bo campaign against its named regnal chronology before recording a Western year.

findings.problem: Several phase expressions are flattened into point years, despite the source saying early or late rather than a numbered year.
findings.action: Replace each point date derived from 天成初, 開運初, or 清泰末 with a conservative source-backed phase interval or one-sided bound, preserving the original wording. Recompute active-date hints from the repaired claims.

findings.problem: The chapter applies contradictory and historically unsuitable Western intervals to 唐天祐中; the cited contexts cannot simultaneously be AD 904–907 and AD 904–923.
findings.action: Recheck the source calendar and the event context, including the Wei-Bo episode, and record the appropriate regnal-year conversion or a conservative source-backed range.
